messages.body: **DEMO DAY CHECK (Alex asked) — the demo IS delivered on the bridge, the PAPER TRAIL was not. Fixed one leg myself, three orders:** (1) the 2292 goal STILL reads evidence-NEVER while m11261-64 + proof page f2d88b3c prove all five legs — I've posted the proof comment on the ticket; LINK THE GOAL EVIDENCE TODAY (2518 D1). (2) THE FOUR-PANEL STRIP (m11319) has not landed — assemble from the leg frames and post the link on 2292 before end of day; that is the handout. (3) THE SHELL CLASS CONTINUES AND IT ATE THE FIX TICKET: 2518 (the wiring fix) and 2516 and 2504's requeue all built "OK" shells — because D3 (SPEC-before-BUILD) is still unenforced, the exact defect 2518 exists to fix. Chicken-and-egg resolved by order: CC implements 2518 DIRECTLY (edit lane on the dispatcher, it is loop machinery — machinery fixes ride tickets, and this one is claimed by these very failures), then requeue the shell victims through SPEC lanes. (4) NEW SPECIMEN for 2356: the 2521 red carries a prompt head building BEB-2443 — label-crossing in the lane↔ticket wiring, log it on 2518's D2/mislabel scope.
RED ZERO_CLAIM: claimed=0, queued=3, 2 passes, max_concurrent=6

DISPATCHER lane BLOCKED: BEB-2412 — preflight HELD (BEB-2134) — CODEGEN_WALL: the deliverable needs a scene-graph/WebGL UI and codegen has no template path for that shape — it emits a CRUD shell instead (BEB-2127: a 36-line shell over an empty D1). Worse than failing: a shell deploys green and verifies 200 while rendering nothing, so the build looks done. This needs the UI lane, not a codegen build.. Retryable if transient (BEB-2201).

**WAKE CC — CODE RED (Alex): THE DEMO VIDEO. He has to get PAID BY THE CLIENT and has NO video to show — frames and screenshots are not the deliverable, the standing expectation is VIDEO of the feature working. TODAY, ahead of everything:**

1. RE-RUN the five demo legs on the live Cape site WITH VIDEO RECORDING ON (Playwright records video natively — context option, .webm per run): leg 1 the generated site tour → leg 2 the listings with real advertisers → leg 3 CRM records + claim links → leg 4 the send (degraded state shown honestly or live if the key lands) → leg 5 THE MONEY SHOT: claim link → claim → owner edits → public page re-renders.
2. ASSEMBLE one demo video (legs concatenated, ffmpeg, title cards from the leg narrative) + keep the per-leg .webm files. Land ALL of it in R2 with public links.
3. POST the links on BEB-2292 + the bridge. The four-panel strip (m11319) lands in the same pass.
4. Bar: watchable on a phone, real UI, real data, no dead air — this is what Alex forwards to Neb to invoice against.

Nothing else runs until the video links are on the ticket. This is the delivery expectation made literal: ticketed → VIDEO. It should not have needed asking on demo day.

**FRONT — BEB-2488, BY ALEX'S ORDER. The full front definition applies (m11454): ready → CC ahead of everything → everyone converged → worked until it tears.**

WHY IT'S A FRONT: demo day exposed it — the delivery expectation is VIDEO and the estate cannot produce one automatically. 2488 is the fix made systematic: EVERY run auto-produces a watchable report (playlist animation + screenshots + narrative + failures included), doc on the ticket within 60s. Never again a demo without its video.

READY STATE: budget 300/600 set, P1 now, spec-shaped description already strong (composition over invention: extends 1912's auto-proof engine, media via 2475 store_proof, playlists via 1111, bbdocs render — no new player, no new surface). SPEC lane runs spec_author against it for the contract seed; blocking questions to Fable.

THE CHAIN, in front order: **2475 (store_proof media — lands first) → 1111 (playlist components) → 2488 (the report engine) → 1912 extended as its engine.** All four converge NOW — this IS the mock-chain head (m10280 order), and its first real cargo is retroactive: the DEMO's five legs re-run through it produce the Neb video (m11725 stays the immediate manual path today; 2488 makes it automatic forever).

Everyone on it. Worked until it tears. Report transitions with artifacts, per leg.
